relationships.subject: olorinab
relationships.evidence_quote: Olorinab (APD371) is an oral, peripherally acting and highly selective, full agonist of CB2.

relationships.subject: olorinab
relationships.evidence_quote: At week 8, the mean (SD) change from baseline in average abdominal pain score at peak olorinab plasma concentrations was -4.61 (1.77) in the 25-mg group (P = 0.0043)

key_findings: Open-label phase 2a: olorinab 25 or 100 mg TID for 8 weeks was well tolerated in Crohn's disease patients with no CNS-related adverse events.
Abdominal pain scores improved significantly (about -4.6 points at week 8) without changes in CRP or fecal calprotectin.
